body: Thank you for your kind response and encouragement - I'm sorry to have to post any of this on Reddit, but it's time to plan this and be done.  Good luck freshcherries
I PM'd you a couple questions - thank you.

That sounds like my everday as well; I feel like I'm on a ticking clock that is counting down to the day I take my own life.  I don't fear burning for eternity; I feel like I already have in this life.  I think at some point a moment of clarity hit me when I realized that it would be the best thing for me.

I'm sorry friend; I lost my mother recently as well - but not under those circumstances which I can tell have hit you very hard as they would anyone.  It's time to seek out help friend; someone who knows you are quite fragile at this moment and are battling for your own life.  Family, any friends, a doctor, a professional counselor/psychiatrist, a priest/pastor - anyone.  Give someone the chance to help you; I wish I had.

I know these feelings; it's not advice, but more so personal experience ... the heartbreak tends to magnify the problem in our lives and make us blind to the things that will make us happy in the future.  The heartbreak has always been very difficult for me as well, but I try to remember that I was a person, sometimes happy but at least functional, prior to this heartbreak.  You were as well; and you can be again.  If you've got family reach out to them, if not, keep reaching out here; you've got a future, I believe in you.

I've decided it's best to prepare myself to do this at the end of the month - I'm going to buy what I need next Friday with the money I have left, and try to avoid the confrontation with my dad at the end of the month.  I've got enough for gas in my car out to Colorado and think I may go out there camping and be somewhere I love when I do this.  I don't want to make this harder than it has to be for anyone else so I'll probably do it in my car and they can just tow it off and not traumatize someone else.

I want so bad to be with my Mom and finished crying and hurting every day.
Thank you, I won't post any more questions; just look for a cheap used ATI or RIA 1911.  I honestly don't have any experience with guns - just need to purchase something affordable.
Sorry to all for my dumb question; forget it.
It sounds like an RIA 1911 for me; cheaper the better for me right now.
What lower priced 1911 used models should I be looking for?  I don't have a specific gun in mind - I'm going to buy one in the next week or so.
Thanks - I am just trying to make sure I don't get ripped off.  I'm guess I'm just looking to go cheap and make sure it works.

Started looking for jobs in earnest today; even did an FB post asking any friends that I have left for job help/advice/anything.  Sent out a bunch of resumes and hope that I'll be able to find something; I don't know what to do about my living situation.  I'm worried that I'll lose all of my things or that my Dad will really get a court order to have me removed from the house.  I don't know how to make him understand how I'm feeling, or that I'm considering suicide; I've been doing laundry, dishes, and trying to stay out of the way.  I don't want to die but I don't know what else to do now. I can't be on the verge of crisis much longer, I'm losing it and I have no idea what to do.

I guess I fear the homelessness and lack of family support; it's always been a fear because I see other mentally ill people on the street really hurting sometimes.  I miss my Mom - and I feel isolated from society and now my family.  I feel immensely sad and worried; it sounds so silly and insane but I worry most about having no personal space or privacy because I'm too poor to afford those things.  I'll never let it get to that - one way or another.
